entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Levi Strauss and Jacob Davis patented riveted denim trousers for gold miners and cowboys. Indigo-dyed cotton twill (denim, from "de Nîmes") proved nearly indestructible. Jeans became America's most iconic garment.
